description: This is a shell script used for testing and managing a Perforce (p4) repository integration, including RCS keyword handling and file scrubbing. It defines test cases for verifying correct behavior of keyword expansion, file editing, and version control interactions with p4 and git.

methods.name: write_scrub_scripts
methods.description: Creates Python scripts for RCS keyword scrubbing.

methods.name: scrub_k_check
methods.description: Checks that a filename's RCS keywords are properly scrubbed with the 'scrub_k.py' script.

methods.name: scrub_ko_check
methods.description: Checks that a filename's RCS keywords are properly scrubbed with the 'scrub_ko.py' script.

methods.name: create_kw_file
methods.description: Creates a C file with RCS keyword placeholders.

methods.name: p4_append_to_file
methods.description: Appends a timestamp comment to a specified file and submits it to p4.
